Class ImplicitCallSites

java.lang.Object
qilin.core.builder.ImplicitCallSites
public class ImplicitCallSites extends Object
The calls that methods perform implicitly, from an ImplicitCallModel. Each implicit invocation is a synthetic statement that the solver dispatches like a virtual call on the points-to set of its receiver; edges from it are attributed to the causing statement in the exported call graph (callSiteOf(InvokableStmt)). A virtual or interface call asks the model again whenever it gets a new target, since rules fire by the targets of the call.
